scope.description: the finding ids this pass verifies: the ids open after the previous pass, plus any closed id whose named locations the fix pass touched again. Absent on pass 1, which verifies every id. `grade` carries a closed id's entry forward when the pass did not cover it

fix_range.description: the range the act verifier reads: the last GRADED pass's head to this pass's head. `range` is the whole round, kept for the record; handing that to the verifier made it re-read every commit of the round to grade one fix.

state_ids.description: the ids the blind state verifier judges this pass: every id in the pass's scope, the open ones and the closed ones re-checked, so nothing is closed, or kept closed, without a blind reading of the corpus it closes in.

rechecked.description: the CLOSED ids this pass re-checks, because the fix pass touched what they name or because the blind verifier never read them. Only the blind verifier reads them: a re-check asks whether an id regressed, and the act verifier's diff holds this pass's work alone.

counted.description: whether this pass spends the instrument's pass budget (`max_passes`). False for a --regrade whose fix range changed no covered file: re-stamping a moved config verifies no new fix.
